title_vi: Các kiểu SQL JOIN hoạt động thế nào?

source_snapshot.note: Pinned commit/path body independently hashed as Git blob; computed OID matches provider tree OID. Non-empty source was read; no source-image bytes used.

related.reason_vi: merge của pandas có các kiểu inner, left, right, outer tương ứng với bốn kiểu JOIN.

claims.evidence: Every result in the lesson was produced by running the SQL in SQLite 3.45.1; sqlite.org was unreachable.

mobile.evidence: Chromium (Playwright) rendered the full lesson at each width with optional sections open; diagram scale measured from the rendered image and every SVG text box checked against the viewBox. Not learner testing and not GitHub or a real phone.

claims.claim_vi: On the lesson's example tables INNER JOIN returns the two matching pairs; LEFT JOIN adds Binh and Chi with NULL orders; RIGHT JOIN adds order 12 with a NULL customer; FULL OUTER JOIN returns five rows.
A NULL-rejecting WHERE condition on a right-table column after a LEFT JOIN removes the unmatched rows (An-10 only for tien > 60), while the same condition in ON keeps Binh and Chi.
LEFT JOIN ... WHERE don.id IS NULL deliberately keeps only the unmatched customers (Binh, Chi), unlike INNER JOIN.
A key matching several rows (An has two orders) yields several result rows.

design_notes_vi: Một ví dụ nhỏ chung cho cả bốn kiểu để so sánh trực tiếp; thẻ cuối là cái bẫy WHERE/ON. Không dùng ảnh nguồn.
source_deviations: Source describes FULL OUTER JOIN as rows with a match in either table; the lesson states that unmatched rows from both sides are kept with NULLs.
Source gives only the four definitions; the lesson adds the WHERE-versus-ON pitfall and the row-multiplication note, both measured.
